The '''Arleen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] known as the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]],<ref name="EAOC" /> specifically in the area falling within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] region.<ref name="TEA" />

The system was the namesake of the [[Arleen Loop]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]], while the [[Falko Run]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked the system to the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon]] and [[Ringneldia system/Legends|Ringneldia systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Arleen system also shared its name with the pleasure [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Arleen]]''.<ref name="Campaign Guide">{{GamerCite|5|A Campaign Guide to the Centrality}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Arleen system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square T-8.<ref name="TEA" />
